title: Optical Signature of Bias-Induced Carrier Injection in a WSe2/MoS2 Heterostructure Diode
summary: We investigate the bias-dependent photoluminescence (PL) response of a WSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructure diode. Under forward bias, trion-related emission in WSe$_2$ is markedly enhanced, whereas reverse bias produces minimal spectral changes. This asymmetric response cannot be explained by electric-field effects alone and instead reflects carrier injection at the functional interface. These results demonstrate that PL provides a direct optical probe of carrier injection in an operating van der Waals heterostructure. More broadly, this approach establishes spatially resolved PL spectroscopy as a versatile tool for pinpointing the interfaces governing device operation in van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 研究WSe2/MoS2异质结二极管的光致发光(PL)偏压依赖性：正偏压下WSe2的三子(trion)发光显著增强，反偏压则光谱变化极小；这种不对称响应源于功能界面的载流子注入而非纯电场效应，证明PL可作为探测工作态范德华异质结载流子注入的直接光学探针。
AI.motivation: 需在器件工作状态下定位并理解范德华异质结中控制器件运行的界面，但缺乏直接、非破坏性的探测手段。
AI.method: 制备WSe2/MoS2异质结二极管，施加正/反偏压并测量其PL光谱响应，对比电场效应与载流子注入的影响。
AI.result: 正偏压下WSe2三子相关发光明显增强，反偏压下光谱几乎不变；该不对称性无法仅由电场效应解释，反映功能界面处的载流子注入。
AI.conclusion: PL可作为工作态范德华异质结载流子注入的直接光学探针；空间分辨PL光谱是定位决定器件运行界面的通用工具。

title: Weak-coupling selection and finite-torus entropy in the triangular Ising antiferromagnet
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23727041
summary: An antiferromagnetic second-neighbor interaction favors stripe order in the triangular-lattice Ising antiferromagnet, but uniform stripes cannot satisfy odd periodic boundaries. At each fixed odd size $L\geq5$, we minimize this interaction over the ground states of the zero-field nearest-neighbor model on an $L\times L$ torus. We prove a minimum total interface length of $4L$ and classify all $L^2(L^2-1)/2$ selected states. Under the uniform measure on these states, the area fractions of the three stripe orientations approach a uniform distribution over all nonnegative triples summing to one. Thus selection reduces an exponential degeneracy to polynomial growth, while the whole-sample orientation fractions remain broadly distributed. We also derive explicit two-sided entropy-density bounds for periodic spin ground states and honeycomb dimer coverings on $M\times N$ tori, where $M,N$ are the periods along the two primitive lattice directions. For all $M,N\geq3$, the errors relative to the bulk residual entropy are bounded by explicit constants times $\min(M,N)^{-2}$, without an aspect-ratio restriction. These bounds give finite-size accuracy guarantees and control the exponentially small fraction of unperturbed ground states that survive the selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究三角晶格Ising反铁磁体在L×L环面上、奇尺寸L下受次近邻反铁磁相互作用选择时基态的分类与熵，并给出周期自旋基态与蜂窝二聚体覆盖的有限尺寸熵密度双侧界。
AI.motivation: 三角晶格Ising反铁磁体存在宏观简并，次近邻相互作用偏好条纹序，但均匀条纹无法满足奇数周期边界，因此需理解该选择机制如何削减简并、以及有限尺寸下熵密度的定量行为。
AI.method: 在固定奇数尺寸L≥5的L×L环面上，对零场最近邻模型的基态最小化次近邻相互作用；证明最小总界面长度为4L，并对全部L²(L²−1)/2个被选中态进行分类。在均匀测度下分析三种条纹取向的面积分数的分布。同时推导M×N环面上周期自旋基态与蜂窝二聚体覆盖的显式双侧熵密度界。
AI.result: 最小总界面长度恰为4L，全部L²(L²−1)/2个选中态被完整分类；三种条纹取向的面积分数趋于三者和为1的非负三元组上的均匀分布，选择把指数级简并降为多项式增长，但整样本取向分数仍分布较宽。对任意M,N≥3，相对体相残余熵的误差上界为显式常数乘min(M,N)⁻²，无长宽比限制。
AI.conclusion: 次近邻相互作用在奇数周期环面上将三角晶格Ising反铁磁体的指数简并压缩为多项式级选择，但仍保留广泛的取向分布；所给双侧熵密度界提供有限尺寸精度保证，并控制了未受扰动基态中经选择幸存者的指数小比例。

title: Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) Semiconductors: A First-Principles Study of Structural, Electronic, Optical, and Energy-Related Properties
summary: We present a comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) investigation of the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and bonding properties of Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) compounds for potential optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications. Structural optimization reveals a systematic expansion of the equilibrium lattice parameters from S to Te. The calculated bulk moduli decrease from 83 GPa for Y2CdS4 to 68 GPa for Y2CdSe4 and 54 GPa for Y2CdTe4, indicating progressive lattice softening. Electronic band-structure calculations predict indirect band gaps of 2.42, 2.08, and 1.71 eV for Y2CdS4, Y2CdSe4, and Y2CdTe4, respectively, with further narrowing upon inclusion of spin-orbit coupling. The calculated dielectric functions, refractive indices, absorption coefficients, reflectivity, optical conductivities, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal systematic changes in optical response across the chalcogen series. The absorption onset shifts toward lower photon energies, from approximately 2.4 eV in Y2CdS4 to 1.7 eV in Y2CdTe4. Thermoelectric calculations indicate promising Seebeck coefficients and power factors, with Y2CdSe4 exhibiting a favorable balance of transport properties. Charge-density distributions, electron localization functions, and Bader charge analyses suggest increasing covalent bonding contributions from sulfide to telluride. These findings highlight the potential of Y2CdX4 compounds for tunable optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications.

AI.tldr: 用DFT系统研究Y2CdX4 (X=S, Se, Te)的结构、力学、电子、光学、热电与成键性质，揭示随硫族元素由S到Te的带隙、模量与光学响应系统性变化规律。
AI.motivation: Y2CdX4系列化合物在光电子与能量转换应用方面具有潜力，但缺乏对其多物理性质（结构、力学、电子、光学、热电、成键）的系统性第一性原理研究，尤其是沿硫族系列(S→Se→Te)的演化规律尚不清晰。
AI.method: 基于密度泛函理论(DFT)的第一性原理计算：结构优化确定平衡晶格参数；计算体模量等力学性质；计算能带结构与带隙（并考虑自旋轨道耦合SOC）；计算介电函数、折射率、吸收系数、反射率、光电导及电子能量损失谱等光学性质；计算Seebeck系数与功率因子等热电性能；结合电荷密度分布、电子局域函数(ELF)与Bader电荷分析研究成键特征。
AI.result: 晶格参数从S到Te系统性增大，体模量由Y2CdS4的83 GPa降至Y2CdSe4的68 GPa、Y2CdTe4的54 GPa，表明晶格逐渐软化。间接带隙分别为2.42、2.08、1.71 eV（S、Se、Te），引入SOC后进一步收窄。吸收起始能量从约2.4 eV(Y2CdS4)红移至约1.7 eV(Y2CdTe4)；介电函数、折射率、吸收系数、反射率、光电导及EELS均随硫族元素呈现系统性变化。热电方面表现出可观的Seebeck系数与功率因子，其中Y2CdSe4的输运性质较为均衡。电荷密度、ELF与Bader电荷分析表明成键共价性从硫化物到碲化物逐渐增强。
AI.conclusion: Y2CdX4 (X=S, Se, Te)化合物具有可由硫族元素调控的带隙、光学响应与成键性质，在可调光电子器件与能量转换（热电）应用方面具有潜力；其中Y2CdSe4在热电输运方面表现尤为均衡。

title: On-the-fly $Δ$-machine learned force fields for warm dense matter using a Yukawa reference model: Application to magnesium
summary: We develop a framework for on-the-fly $Δ$-machine learned force field ($Δ$-MLFF) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of warm dense matter (WDM). In particular, we employ a Yukawa reference model that captures the dominant screened-Coulomb interactions between the ions, with its parameters fit on the fly to Kohn--Sham density functional theory (DFT) data, and an MLFF scheme based on the kernel method and Bayesian linear regression that learns the differences in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses between the Yukawa model and Kohn--Sham DFT. We verify the accuracy and performance of the formalism by comparing the predicted properties of warm dense carbon with Kohn--Sham DFT results in the literature. In so doing, we demonstrate that $Δ$-MLFF has significantly lower errors in the energies, atomic forces, and stresses than the standard MLFF scheme at a comparable cost, while accelerating ab initio MD simulations by up to three orders of magnitude. We apply this framework to calculate the equation of state, structure, and transport properties of magnesium at densities of 5.22 to 10.44 g/cm$^3$ and temperatures of 600 kK to 1.5 MK. We find that the pressure, self-diffusion coefficient, and shear viscosity obey power laws in temperature and density, that the dynamic structure factor exhibits a well-defined ion-acoustic mode whose negative dispersion is characteristic of strongly coupled liquids, and that the Stokes--Einstein relation holds to within 10% over the conditions considered.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在线Δ-机器学习力场（Δ-MLFF）分子动力学框架，用于温稠密物质（WDM）模拟：以Yukawa参考模型描述离子屏蔽库仑作用并在线拟合于Kohn–Sham DFT数据，用核方法+贝叶斯线性回归学习与DFT的能量/力/应力差。相比标准MLFF精度更高、成本相当，比从头算MD快达三个数量级；并用于计算镁在5.22–10.44 g/cm³、600 kK–1.5 MK下的状态方程、结构与输运性质。
AI.motivation: 温稠密物质模拟需兼顾DFT精度与大规模长时间MD的效率，纯从头算MD代价过高，而标准MLFF在极端条件下误差偏大，因此需要一种既保精度又省成本的方案。
AI.method: 构建Yukawa参考模型刻画离子间主导的屏蔽库仑相互作用，其参数在线拟合Kohn–Sham DFT数据；采用基于核方法与贝叶斯线性回归的MLFF学习Yukawa模型与DFT之间在能量、原子力与应力上的差异（Δ学习）。以温稠密碳对标文献DFT结果验证，再应用于镁。
AI.result: 在相当成本下，Δ-MLFF在能量、原子力和应力上的误差显著低于标准MLFF，同时将从头算MD加速多达三个数量级。对镁所得压力、自扩散系数与剪切黏度在温度与密度上服从幂律；动态结构因子呈现清晰的离子声学支，其负色散是强耦合液体的特征；Stokes–Einstein关系在考察条件内误差在10%以内成立。
AI.conclusion: Δ-MLFF是研究温稠密物质的高效高精度框架，可系统给出状态方程、结构与输运性质；对镁的结果揭示了强耦合液体特征及可用幂律与Stokes–Einstein关系描述的规律。

title: The Halperin (111) state as a paired composite-fermion wave function: Two exact finite-size identities on the sphere
summary: Two wavefunctions have previously been proposed to describe the $ν=1/2+1/2$ quantum Hall bilayer: $p$-wave pairing of composite fermions and $s$-wave pairing of composite fermions with anti-composite fermions. We show analytically in the spherical geometry and within the Jain-Kamilla lowest Landau level projection scheme that both of these paired composite fermion wavefunctions exactly reproduce the Halperin (111) state for a specific form of the pairing that we derive. We also find a second wavefunction that is common between both classes of wavefunctions. However, we provide evidence the two variational families generate overlapping but not identical sets of electronic states, ruling out a universal reparametrization that identifies their wavefunctions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在球面几何与Jain-Kamilla最低朗道能级投影下，复合费米子p波配对与复合费米子-反复合费米子s波配对的波函数在特定配对形式下均精确给出Halperin (111)态，并发现第二类共有波函数；但两变分族只重叠不等价，不存在统一重参数化。
AI.motivation: 此前对ν=1/2+1/2量子霍尔双层提出了两种波函数描述（复合费米子p波配对、复合费米子与反复合费米子s波配对），二者关系不明，需要厘清它们是否等价或可统一。
AI.method: 在球面几何下，采用Jain-Kamilla最低朗道能级投影方案，对两类配对复合费米子波函数进行解析推导，并构造出使其精确等于Halperin (111)态的具体配对形式；同时寻找两类之间的共同波函数。
AI.result: 推导出使两类配对波函数均精确复现Halperin (111)态的具体配对形式，并发现第二个共有波函数；同时给出证据表明两变分族生成的是相互重叠但不完全相同的电子态集合。
AI.conclusion: 两种配对图像在特定配对下共享Halperin (111)态等共有态，但并不等价，因此不存在将其波函数相互识别的普适重参数化。

title: In the age of big data and AI: do we still need chemical bonds?
summary: Chemical bonding is the language through which chemistry rationalizes materials structure, stability, properties, and reactivity. Meanwhile, modern deep-learning models achieve remarkable predictive performance using representations based largely on compositional and structural information, raising the question of whether explicit bonding concepts remain necessary. In this work, we argue that artificial intelligence does not render chemical bonding obsolete but provides a new framework for evaluating and refining bonding concepts. We show that, through linear probing, Allegro and MACE embeddings recover bonding descriptors with (R^2 > 0.95), indicating that bonding emerges naturally from Allegro's and MACE's latent spaces. We also show that bonding descriptors provide information beyond bond distance in our electronic-structure-featurized MEGNet (ESF-MEGNet) model, reducing prediction error for properties including bulk and shear moduli by 15%. We discuss implications for interpretable machine learning, synthesizability prediction, and generative materials design, and suggest joint-embedding approaches for learning more general bonding representations. More broadly, we propose that chemical bonding can be understood as a learnable representation of electronic structure. From this perspective, different bonding models represent alternative compressions of the underlying electronic information and can be evaluated through their predictive power, dimensionality, and complexity. The age of machine learning shifts the focus from whether a bonding model is physically motivated to whether it captures the information required to explain and predict materials behavior. If a materials genome exists, it should be encodable through a representation of chemical bonding. If no bonding representation can capture this information, our understanding of the chemical bond may require revision.

AI.tldr: 论文主张AI并未使化学键概念过时，而是提供了评估与改进键合概念的新框架：键合可视为电子结构的可学习表示。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习模型主要依赖成分与结构信息即可取得优异预测性能，令人质疑显式化学键概念是否仍必要。作者意图回应这一疑问，重新定位化学键在机器学习时代的角色。
AI.method: 采用线性探针检验Allegro与MACE嵌入能否恢复键合描述符；构建ESF-MEGNet（将电子结构特征化的MEGNet）来检验键合描述符在键长之外是否提供额外信息；并提出联合嵌入方法以学习更通用的键合表示。
AI.result: Allegro和MACE的潜在空间可高精度恢复键合描述符（R²>0.95），说明键合信息自然涌现；在ESF-MEGNet中，键合描述符在键长之外提供额外信息，使体积模量和剪切模量等性质的预测误差降低15%。
AI.conclusion: 化学键应被理解为电子结构的可学习表示，不同键合模型是对底层电子信息的替代性压缩，可通过预测力、维度和复杂度评估。机器学习将关注点从“键合模型是否有物理动机”转向“是否涵盖解释与预测材料行为所需信息”；若存在材料基因组，应能通过化学键表示编码。

title: Ab initio exploration of hydrogen-intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides: From identifying stable structures to emergent superconductivity
comment: 32 pages (11 pages main text with 6 figures and 2 tables, plus 21 pages of supplemental material). Submitted to Physical Review Materials
summary: We present a first-principles study of hydrogen-intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), examining the structural, thermodynamic, electronic and superconducting properties of distinct intercalation configurations. In most configurations, the two intercalated hydrogen atoms contribute two electrons per unit cell, creating a band gap and thus rendering the system semiconducting. Among the dynamically stable configurations there is one exception to this rule, with inherently metallic behavior. The pristine phases of these materials are known to exhibit a charge density wave instability, which is fully suppressed by specific hydrogen configurations. Moreover, the semiconducting structures can be metallized by hole doping, albeit that the superconducting critical temperatures ($T_c$) are vanishingly low. On the other hand, electron doping drives the $T_c$ up to 25 K, by populating dense states above the gap. This finding can motivate further experimental exploration of superconductivity in hydrogen-intercalated TMDs through ionic-liquid gating or alkali co-intercalation.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理系统研究氢插层过渡金属硫族化合物，氢原子贡献两电子打开带隙使其半导体化，抑制电荷密度波；空穴掺杂难超导，而电子掺杂可把Tc提升至25 K。
AI.motivation: 探索氢插层TMD的结构、热力学、电子与超导性质，并考察不同插层构型带来的物性差异，以及插层对原有电荷密度波不稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理（DFT）计算，系统分析多种氢插层构型的结构稳定性（动力学稳定性）、热力学、电子结构及超导性质；并通过空穴/电子掺杂研究其金属化与超导转变温度。
AI.result: 多数构型中每单胞两个氢原子贡献两个电子，打开带隙呈半导体性；动力学稳定构型中有一例外保持金属性。特定氢构型完全抑制了母体相的电荷密度波不稳定性。空穴掺杂可使半导体结构金属化，但Tc极低；电子掺杂则填充带隙上方的密集态，使Tc升高至约25 K。
AI.conclusion: 氢插层TMD是可调控带隙与CDW的材料平台，电子掺杂（如离子液体门控或碱金属共插层）有望实现较高温超导，值得进一步实验探索。

title: The Agentic AI Kerr Lab: LLM Agents for Kerr Microscopy Experiments with Magnetic Skyrmions
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Contribution to the proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on AI for Science (AI4Sci 2026), Mainz, Germany, 5-9 October 2026. Supplementary video: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23736472
summary: Magnetic skyrmions are topological spin textures that can be observed directly by magnetic microscopy and driven by fields and currents, which makes them a model system for fundamental physics and candidates for spintronic devices. Magneto-optical Kerr microscopy is a method to image them in real time; however, most experiments use an inefficient cycle of consecutive imaging, analysis and excitation in which every step requires the judgement of the experimentalist operating the setup. Here we present the Agentic AI Kerr Lab (AgentKerr), in which an agent based on a large language model operates this cycle automatically and efficiently on a Kerr microscope. Rather than relying on pattern detection by a language model, a convolutional neural network trained on Kerr images turns live images into skyrmion observables such as position, size and shape, on which the agent bases its decisions. The architecture lets agents operate the instruments safely, as every hardware action is checked deterministically against an action policy, independently of the agent that issues it. With no procedure given, the agent determines by itself how to create, tune and move skyrmions, and writes its own analyses. The approach can be transferred to other spin textures and points towards magnetic imaging experiments in which the researcher poses the question and the agent finds the way to realize the experiments that yield the answer.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentKerr，用基于大语言模型的智能体在 Kerr 显微镜上自动完成磁斯格明子的成像-分析-激发闭环；用 CNN 从图像提取位置/尺寸/形状等可观测量，动作经确定性策略校验保证安全；无给定流程下智能体能自主学会创建、调节与移动斯格明子并自写分析。
AI.motivation: 磁斯格明子可用磁光克尔显微镜实时成像，但多数实验仍依赖"成像—分析—激发"的人工循环，每步都需操作者判断，效率低且难自动化。
AI.method: 构建 Agentic AI Kerr Lab：LLM 智能体负责决策；由 Kerr 图像训练的 CNN 将实时图像转为位置、尺寸、形状等可观测量，供智能体决策（而非让语言模型直接做模式检测）；硬件动作由确定性动作策略独立校验，保障安全。
AI.result: 在未给定任何实验流程的情况下，智能体自主确定了创建、调节和移动斯格明子的方法，并自行编写分析程序。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可推广到其他自旋织构，指向"研究者提问题、智能体寻找实现路径"的磁成像实验范式。

title: Quantum dynamics of ultrasmall magnetic skyrmions in atomic-defect landscapes
summary: Magnetic skyrmions are prime candidates for future information technology, and their fate in devices is settled by the defects they encounter. In ultrathin films, skyrmions can be as small as a couple of nanometers, carrying only a few tens of magnetic moments, while atomic defects reshape their energy landscape on the atomic scale. Here, we demonstrate that such ultrasmall skyrmions can behave quantum mechanically and that their quantum dynamics is unusual. Since the gyrotropic force dominates, the two coordinates of a ferromagnetic skyrmion are canonically conjugate and the skyrmion behaves as a particle in the lowest Landau level of an effective magnetic field, with a magnetic length of 0.6~Å. Utilizing skyrmion-defect interaction profiles of Cr and Fe adatoms and dimers in PdFe/Ir(111), obtained from atomistic spin simulations parametrized from first principles, we unveil quantized gyrotropic orbits with level spacings of 20--85~$μ$eV, bound not only by pinning defects but also, counter-intuitively, by repulsive ones. Saddle points of the energy landscape act as quantum beam splitters for skyrmions, and quantum depinning reaches rates of 1--100~Hz below the critical current. Embedded impurities, in contrast, bind the skyrmion so strongly that it ceases to behave as a rigid particle, defining a strong-coupling regime. For the Gilbert damping typical of ultrathin films, the quantized levels remain well resolved. The thermal-to-quantum crossover lies between 40 and 160~mK, which is within reach of millikelvin scanning tunneling microscopy, where tip-induced escape statistics and electron spin resonance STM can reveal the quantized gyrotropic motion of skyrmions pinned at defects crafted atom by atom.

AI.tldr: 超小磁斯格明子在缺陷势中可表现量子行为，其两个坐标因回旋力成为共轭量，形成最低朗道能级，能级间距20-85 μeV，热-量子交叉温度40-160 mK，可用mK-ST微观测。
AI.motivation: 磁斯格明子是未来信息技术候选载体，其在器件中的命运由遇到的缺陷决定；超薄膜中斯格明子可小至几纳米、仅携带数十个磁矩，而原子缺陷在原子尺度重塑其能量景观。作者希望探究这种超小斯格明子是否展现量子力学行为及其量子动力学特性。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理参数化的原子尺度自旋模拟，获得PdFe/Ir(111)上Cr、Fe吸附原子及二聚体与斯格明子的相互作用势；利用回旋力主导下两坐标正则共轭的性质，将斯格明子映射为有效磁场最低朗道能级中的粒子（磁长0.6 Å），并分析量子化回旋轨道、鞍点量子分束与量子脱钉。
AI.result: 发现量子化回旋轨道，能级间距20-85 μeV；斯格明子不仅被钉扎缺陷束缚，也被排斥型缺陷束缚；能量景观鞍点充当量子分束器，临界电流以下量子脱钉率达1-100 Hz；嵌入型杂质强耦合使斯格明子失去刚性粒子行为；典型超薄膜Gilbert阻尼下量子能级仍良好分辨；热-量子交叉温度40-160 mK。
AI.conclusion: 超小磁斯格明子可呈现量子化的回旋运动，交叉温度在mK扫描隧道显微镜可达范围内；通过针尖诱导逃逸统计与电子自旋共振STM，可在原子级制备的缺陷上观测斯格明子的量子化回旋运动。

title: Evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
summary: Correlations and topology are central pillars in the study of emergent electronic phases. Topological flat bands near the Fermi level unite these concepts, providing a route towards correlated topological phenomena and unconventional magnetism. Despite theoretical predictions, momentum-resolved observation of a topological flat band at the Fermi level has remained elusive. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we observe a flat band at the Fermi level within the topologically non-trivial electronic structure of the magnetic kagome Weyl semimetal Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$. We further uncover a strong temperature dependence in which the flat band shifts across the Fermi level, accompanied by a reconstruction of the Fermi surface. Strikingly, this evolution occurs on the same temperature scale as previously reported anomalies in the magnetic response. Together, these results provide evidence for topological flat band magnetism in Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$, establishing a microscopic setting in which topology, electronic correlations, and magnetism become intertwined.

AI.tldr: 利用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)在磁性kagome Weyl半金属Co3Sn2S2中观测到位于费米能级的拓扑平带，并发现其随温度跨越费米能级移动、费米面重构，与磁响应异常同温标发生，为"拓扑平带磁性"提供证据。
AI.motivation: 关联性与拓扑是研究涌现电子态的核心支柱，费米能级附近的拓扑平带将二者结合，可通向关联拓扑现象与非规磁性。尽管理论已有预测，但在费米能级处对拓扑平带进行动量分辨观测始终难以实现。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)，对磁性kagome Weyl半金属Co3Sn2S2的拓扑非平庸电子结构进行动量分辨测量，追踪费米能级处平带及费米面随温度的变化。
AI.result: 在Co3Sn2S2的拓扑非平庸电子结构中观测到费米能级处的平带；该平带随温度发生强烈变化，跨越费米能级并伴随费米面重构，且演化发生的温标与此前报道的磁响应异常一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果为Co3Sn2S2中的"拓扑平带磁性"提供证据，建立起拓扑、电子关联与磁性相互交织的微观图像。

title: Quantum Dipolar Magnon Drag in Conducting Magnetic Bilayers
summary: We predict electrical drag between two electrically isolated metallic ferromagnets mediated by quantum dipolar magnon coupling. A charge current in one layer generates a nonequilibrium magnon current whose momentum is transferred across an insulating spacer through interlayer dipolar interactions. The resulting magnon current in the passive layer produces a measurable voltage through electron-magnon scattering. We show the combination of resonant quantum momentum transfer and magnetic tunability through the control of magnetization configurations distinguish quantum dipolar drag from conventional drag mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文预言两个电绝缘金属铁磁体之间由量子偶极磁振子耦合介导的电拖曳效应：一层中的电荷流产生非平衡磁振子流，其动量经层间偶极相互作用穿过绝缘间隔层传递，在被动层中通过电子-磁振子散射产生可测电压。
AI.motivation: 探索由量子偶极磁振子耦合介导的新型拖曳机制，并寻找能与传统拖曳机制区分的实验特征，从而为无电荷输运的磁振子-电子耦合提供新的研究途径。
AI.method: 理论预测/分析：构建两层电绝缘金属铁磁体夹绝缘间隔层的结构，计算电荷流驱动的非平衡磁振子流通过层间偶极相互作用实现动量转移，并在被动层中通过电子-磁振子散射转为电压。
AI.result: 被动层中出现可测电压；共振量子动量转移与通过磁化构型调控的磁可调性共同构成了区别于传统拖曳机制的显著特征。
AI.conclusion: 量子偶极拖曳是一个可观测、可调控的输运现象，其共振与磁化构型依赖性可用于识别该机制，并为磁振子学与自旋电子学的耦合研究提供新平台。

title: Helical Magnetic Nature of $β$-Mn Structured CoZn Thin-Films Determined by a Bayesian Approach to Modeling Polarized Neutron Reflectivity Data
summary: Chiral magnetic materials can host skyrmions and hence are of interest for numerous spintronic applications including low-power storage. To reach this goal, room temperature operation and a thin film form are needed. We have studied the chiral magnetism in a $β$-Mn structured CoZn sputtered film, with a Curie temperature of $\approx 130$ °C, by means of polarized neutron reflectometry (PNR) in order to reveal its magnetic field-temperature phase diagram. In bulk this material has a helimagnetic ground state. Here we use PNR data to show that the helimagnetism survives in a CoZn film only 100 nm thick, roughly half a helical period. Given the subtlety of differentiating the helical state from a uniform state with reduced interfacial magnetism, we have developed and employed a Bayesian approach that uses model selection to analyze our PNR data and to map out the field-temperature phase diagram of our thin film.

AI.tldr: 研究100 nm厚β-Mn结构CoZn溅射薄膜的手性磁性，用极化中子反射谱结合贝叶斯模型选择方法，证明螺旋磁序在薄膜中存活并绘制了磁场-温度相图。
AI.motivation: 手性磁材料可承载skyrmion，有望用于低功耗自旋电子存储，但实际应用需室温工作和薄膜形态。块体CoZn具有螺旋磁基态，需验证其手性磁序能否在薄膜中保留，并厘清其磁相图。
AI.method: 对居里温度约130 °C的β-Mn结构CoZn溅射薄膜（厚100 nm，约为半个螺旋周期）进行极化中子反射谱（PNR）测量；由于螺旋态与"界面磁性降低的均匀态"难以区分，作者发展并采用贝叶斯方法，通过模型选择来分析PNR数据并绘制磁场-温度相图。
AI.result: PNR数据表明螺旋磁序在仅100 nm厚的CoZn薄膜中依然存在；贝叶斯模型选择有效区分了螺旋态与均匀态，并据此构建出该薄膜的磁场-温度相图。
AI.conclusion: 手性螺旋磁性可在远薄于螺旋周期的CoZn薄膜中存活，为薄膜型skyrmion自旋电子器件提供了材料依据；贝叶斯模型选择是解析此类微弱磁信号PNR数据的有效手段。

title: Effect of Rapid Thermal Annealing on the Superconductivity of ALD-Grown TiN thin films
summary: Titanium nitride (TiN) is a promising superconducting material for scalable quantum technologies owing to its tunable kinetic inductance and compatibility with CMOS thin-film processing. However, the superconducting performance of atomic-layer-deposited TiN can be degraded by oxygen incorporation, off-stoichiometry, and crystallographic disorder. In this work, we investigate rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in high-purity nitrogen as a post-deposition strategy to improve polycrystalline TiN films grown by RF-biased plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction reveals reduced peak broadening, a smaller lattice parameter, and a stronger (111) preferred orientation with increasing annealing temperature. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling shows reduced oxygen-related bonding and a shift toward a Ti--N-dominated chemical environment after annealing. These structural and chemical changes result in a 25% increase in the superconducting transition temperature and a significant narrowing of the transition width. Annealing also reduced the sheet resistance and the estimated sheet kinetic inductance, increased the residual resistance ratio, and improved the magnetic-field tolerance. Together, the structural, chemical, and transport results are consistent with reduced material disorder and improved superconducting uniformity. Because RTA is a relatively low thermal budget and is a semiconductor fabrication compatible process, it offers a practical route to improve the quality of ALD-grown TiN for superconducting applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对RF偏压PEALD生长的多晶TiN进行高纯氮快速热退火(RTA)，改善了结构与化学质量，使超导转变温度提升25%、转变宽度收窄，并降低方阻与动能电感，证明RTA是提升ALD-TiN超导性能的低热预算可行工艺。
AI.motivation: TiN因可调动能电感和CMOS兼容性而成为可扩展量子技术的有前景超导材料，但原子层沉积TiN的超导性能会因氧掺入、非化学计量比和晶格无序而退化，因此需要一种后处理手段来改善薄膜质量。
AI.method: 以高纯氮中的快速热退火(RTA)作为后沉积处理，作用于RF偏压等离子体增强ALD生长的多晶TiN薄膜；通过掠入射XRD分析晶体结构与取向，通过XPS深度剖析表征化学键合与氧含量，并结合输运与超导性能测试评估退火效果。
AI.result: 随退火温度升高，XRD峰展宽减小、晶格参数变小、(111)择优取向增强；XPS显示氧相关键合减少、Ti–N主导的化学环境增强。相应地，超导转变温度提高25%、转变宽度显著变窄，方阻与估计的方阻动能电感下降，剩余电阻比提高，磁场耐受性改善。
AI.conclusion: 结构、化学与输运结果一致表明材料无序减少、超导均匀性提高；由于RTA热预算较低且与半导体制造工艺兼容，它是改善ALD生长TiN质量以用于超导器件的实用途径。

title: Validation of the five-electron pO qubit in Si using full configuration interaction
summary: The $pO$ qubit is a recently proposed charge qubit consisting of five electrons confined in a gate-defined Si quantum dot. Because its two qubit states have no dipole moment, it couples to electric fields only through the quadrupole moment, suppressing the dominant decoherence channel of conventional charge qubits while retaining all-electrical control. The original proposal was formulated in a shell-filling picture without Coulomb interactions. In this work we perform full configuration interaction (FCI) calculations to assess the impact of the Coulomb interaction on the viability of the $pO$ qubit. We find that the interacting eigenstates occupy orbital shells beyond the shell-filling picture, with the degree of excitation governed by the competition between valley splitting, orbital energy, and Coulomb energy scales. Additionally, we find that the ground states form degenerate doublets, but of two distinct kinds. Above a crossover near a valley splitting of $E_{\rm{VS}}\approx50~μ$eV the doublet is a pair of orbital angular momentum excitations with $|\langle L_z\rangle|=1$ in the lower valley, while below the crossover the doublet is a pair of single valley excitations with $\langle L_z\rangle=0$. Despite this substantial departure from the shell-filling picture, for $E_{\rm{VS}} > 50~μ$eV the essential features, vanishing dipole moments and nonzero quadrupole tensor between qubit states are preserved. We show that the vanishing dipole is in fact guaranteed by the symmetry properties of the five-electron Hamiltonian. The same energy scales that govern the orbital occupation also set the quadrupole tensor elements and the first excited state energy gap, both of which are in principle tunable through device engineering.

AI.tldr: 用FCI计算检验Coulomb相互作用对pO量子比特可行性的影响，发现尽管能态显著偏离壳层填充图像，关键的四极矩耦合特征在E_VS>50μeV时仍保持。
AI.motivation: pO比特把5个电子束缚在栅极定义的Si量子点中，两比特态无偶极矩、仅通过四极矩耦合电场，从而抑制传统电荷比特的主要退相干通道且保留全电控制。原始方案基于无Coulomb相互作用的壳层填充图像，其在实际强关联条件下的有效性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对5电子量子点进行全组态相互作用（FCI）计算，纳入Coulomb相互作用，考察相互作用本征态、基态简并结构、偶极/四极矩矩阵元及激发能隙，并与谷劈裂、轨道能和Coulomb能尺度进行比较。
AI.result: 相互作用本征态占据超出壳层填充图像的轨道壳层，激发程度由谷劈裂、轨道能与Coulomb能的竞争决定；基态形成简并二重态，在E_VS≈50μeV附近发生交叉：上方为下谷中|⟨L_z⟩|=1的轨道角动量激发对，下方为⟨L_z⟩=0的单谷激发对。当E_VS>50μeV时，比特态间偶极矩为零、四极矩张量非零的关键特征仍保留；零偶极可由五电子哈密顿量的对称性保证。
AI.conclusion: Coulomb相互作用虽使pO比特的能态结构显著偏离壳层填充图像，但在E_VS>50μeV区间不破坏其核心工作机理；四极矩张量元与第一激发态能隙由同一组能量尺度决定，可通过器件工程调节。

title: Physics-informed X-ray tomography of magnetization and material parameters
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 5 Extended Data figures, 1 Extended Data table
summary: Three-dimensional spin textures are stabilized by microscopic interactions within their host materials. X-ray vector tomography can image these nanoscale structures, but weak magnetic contrast and a limited range of viewing angles often leave parts of the magnetization poorly determined. Here we show that a reconstruction constrained by the micromagnetic energy recovers the three-dimensional magnetization from such data and gains sensitivity to the underlying material interactions. Applied to the chiral magnet Co$_8$Zn$_9$Mn$_3$, the method resolves the three-dimensional helical texture even from a small fraction of the dual-axis projections typically required for a successful tomographic reconstruction, or from a single tilt axis alone. By testing which ratio of exchange to Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in the reconstruction best reproduces the measured projections, we obtain a value for the sample that differs by about 10 % from the literature value derived from the helical winding period. Taken together, our findings suggest a way to reduce the time needed for vector tomography and to extend it to determining fundamental magnetic interactions in a material.

AI.tldr: 提出以微磁能量约束的三维磁化重建方法，可从少量X射线矢量层析投影数据中恢复螺旋磁结构，并反演出材料的交换与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用之比。
AI.motivation: 三维自旋织构由材料内部微观相互作用决定，X射线矢量层析虽可成像纳米尺度磁结构，但磁对比弱、可视角范围有限，导致部分磁化方向欠定，且通常需要大量双轴投影数据，耗时长。
AI.method: 在重建中引入微磁能量约束（交换作用与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用），对Co₈Zn₉Mn₃手性磁体进行X射线矢量层析重建；并通过比较不同交换/DMI比值下重建结果与实测投影的吻合程度来反演该比值。
AI.result: 仅用通常所需双轴投影的一小部分、甚至单一倾转轴数据即可解析出三维螺旋织构；反演得到的交换/DMI比值与由螺旋周期推导的文献值相差约10%。
AI.conclusion: 微磁能量约束的重建可缩短矢量层析所需时间，并将层析技术拓展为测定材料基本磁相互作用的手段。

title: Machine Learning Aided Computational Discovery of Boride Substrates for Borophene Synthesis
comment: Manuscript: 24 pages including references, 6 figures. Supporting Information: 16 pages
summary: Borophene, a monolayer of boron, is distinctive among two-dimensional materials owing to its unique properties, including polymorphism and potential applications in quantum technologies and energy conversion and storage. Nevertheless, its applications are hindered by the strong binding of borophene to metal substrates, which impedes the realization of freestanding borophene. Alternative substrates with tunable binding to borophene are therefore highly desirable. Since boride layers arise during borophene synthesis on metals, borides provide potential alternative substrates for borophene synthesis. In this work, we investigate the binding energies and interactions between borophene and 1356 boride surfaces for two borophene phases (v1/6 and v1/9), using density functional theory (DFT) calculations and machine learning (ML). Importantly, incorporating ML-predicted charge transfer as an input feature to a subsequent ML model enables physics-informed predictions of binding energies. Additional DFT calculations on four representative cases were performed to validate the ML predictions. SHAP analysis reveals that the majority of key descriptors are associated with delocalized electrons, highlighting the role of electronic properties in governing binding strength. Combined DFT and ML screening identifies 65 and 73 promising boride surfaces for the v1/6 and v1/9 phases, respectively. Al- and Ag-based borides, including AlB2 and AgB2, emerge as predominant candidates for both phases. The computationally predicted candidate substrates and the deduced design guidelines provide a charge-transfer-informed ML strategy for substrate selection and represent promising steps toward the experimental realization of freestanding borophene.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合DFT与机器学习，系统筛选1356种硼化物表面对两种硼烯相（v1/6和v1/9）的结合能，发现以机器学习预测的电荷转移作为物理信息输入可提升结合能预测精度，并筛选出65/73个有前景的候选衬底（以AlB2、AgB2为代表）。
AI.motivation: 硼烯虽有独特性质，但其与金属衬底结合过强，难以实现自支撑结构，亟需可调结合强度的替代衬底；而硼烯合成中常出现的硼化物层为潜在替代衬底提供了可能。
AI.method: 对1356种硼化物表面与两种硼烯相（v1/6、v1/9）进行DFT结合能计算；训练ML模型，并将ML预测的电荷转移作为额外输入特征实现物理信息驱动的结合能预测；用4个代表性案例的DFT计算验证；采用SHAP分析识别关键描述符。
AI.result: 物理信息ML模型可准确预测结合能；SHAP表明多数关键描述符与离域电子相关，说明电子性质主导结合强度；筛选出v1/6相65个、v1/9相73个有前景的硼化物衬底，其中Al基和Ag基硼化物（如AlB2、AgB2）为两相的主要候选。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种基于电荷转移信息的ML衬底筛选策略与设计准则，为硼烯衬底选择提供指导，是迈向自支撑硼烯实验实现的重要一步。

title: Nodeless $d$-wave superconductivity driven by charge fluctuations in monolayer FeSe on SrTiO$_3$
summary: Monolayer FeSe and Fe(Te,Se) grown on SrTiO$_3$ exhibit some of the highest superconducting transition temperatures among iron-based superconductors, yet their pairing mechanism and symmetry remain elusive. Motivated by the recent surprising discovery of nodeless $d$-wave superconductivity using scanning Josephson tunneling microscopy (SJTM) [T. Wei et al., arXiv:2610.38421 (2026)], we investigate superconductivity in monolayer FeSe/SrTiO$3$ (1L-FeSe/STO) within an extended Hubbard model incorporating both onsite and intersite Coulomb interactions among Fe $3d$ and Se $4p$ orbitals. We show that Fe-Se intersite Coulomb repulsion strongly enhances small-momentum $p$-$d$ charge-transfer fluctuations, which mediate attractive intraorbital spin-singlet pairing interactions. These electronic fluctuations may be further enhanced by forward-scattering optical phonons of the SrTiO$3$ substrate. The resulting intrapocket attraction, together with residual repulsive interpocket interactions, stabilizes a mirror-odd, nodeless $B_{1g}$ ($d$-wave) superconducting state with opposite gap signs on the two electron pockets. Both Fe $t_{2g}$ and Se $4p$ orbitals contribute substantially to this multiorbital superconductivity. The calculated superconducting gap and density of states exhibit a two-peak structure, while the Josephson tunneling conductance displays a half-lattice-period modulation, in excellent agreement with experimental observations. Our results establish electronic charge-transfer fluctuations as a viable pairing mechanism for unconventional nodeless $d$-wave superconductivity in monolayer FeSe/STO.

AI.tldr: 在Fe 3d与Se 4p的多轨道扩展Hubbard模型中，Fe-Se间位库仑排斥增强小动量p-d电荷转移涨落，由此产生的带内自旋单态吸引配对稳定了镜像奇、无节点的B1g (d波) 超导态，解释了单层FeSe/STO的SJTM实验结果。
AI.motivation: 单层FeSe/Fe(Te,Se)在SrTiO3上具有铁基超导最高Tc之一，但配对机制与对称性长期未定；近期扫描约瑟夫森隧道显微镜发现无节点d波超导这一意外结果，亟需理论解释。
AI.method: 构建包含Fe 3d与Se 4p轨道、并计入在位与格点间库仑相互作用的扩展Hubbard模型；分析Fe-Se间位库仑排斥诱导的小动量p-d电荷转移涨落及其对带内自旋单态配对的贡献，并考虑STO衬底前向散射光学声子的增强作用，求解多轨道超导态与隧道谱。
AI.result: Fe-Se格点间库仑排斥显著增强p-d电荷转移涨落，产生带内吸引；结合残余带间排斥作用，稳定了在双电子口袋上符号相反的镜像奇、无节点B1g d波态，Fe t2g与Se 4p轨道均有实质贡献。计算得到的超导能隙与态密度呈双峰结构，约瑟夫森隧道电导呈现半晶格周期调制，与实验高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 电子型电荷转移涨落可作为单层FeSe/STO中非常规无节点d波超导的可行配对机制，并同时解释了SJTM观测到的能隙结构与半晶格周期调制。

title: RIXS study of strain-tuned coupled valence and spin-state transition in epitaxial $(\mathrm{Pr}_{0.85}\mathrm{Y}_{0.15})_{0.7}\mathrm{Ca}_{0.3}\mathrm{CoO}_{3}$ films
summary: Strain-tuned $(\mathrm{Pr}_{0.85}\mathrm{Y}_{0.15})_{0.7}\mathrm{Ca}_{0.3}\mathrm{CoO}_{3}$ thin films provide a model system for controlling coupled valence, spin-state, structural and metal-insulator transitions (VSSTs) in perovskite cobaltite materials. Here, we use Co $L_{2,3}$ and Pr $M_{4,5}$ X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS), along with Co $L_{3}$ edge Resonant Inelastic X-ray Scattering (RIXS), to probe the local electronic structure across the strain-controlled VSST in epitaxial (Pr,Y,Ca)CoO$_{3}$ thin films. In compressively strained films on YAlO$_{3}$ (YAO) substrates, cooling through the transition produces Pr$^{4+}$-like spectral weight, suppresses Co$^{4+}$-like character, and favors predominantly low-spin Co$^{3+}$. The changes at the Pr and Co edges are quantitatively consistent with a reduction of approximately 0.15 holes per Co in the Co--O network. By contrast, tensile-strained thin films on La$_{0.18}$Sr$_{0.82}$Al$_{0.59}$Ta$_{0.41}$O$_{3}$ (LSAT) substrates have nearly temperature-independent spectra. Multiplet calculations reproduce the principal XAS lineshapes and local $dd$ excitations at high energy loss. Additionally, low-energy RIXS intensity recovered above the transition is consistent with a combination of Co$^{4+}$-like local excitations and a broader particle--hole continuum associated with the metallic phase. These results provide element-resolved evidence for charge compensation between the Pr and Co--O sublattices and support cooperative coupling among charge-transfer, spin-state, and lattice structure at the strain-controlled VSST.

AI.tldr: 利用Co L₂,₃与Pr M₄,₅ XAS及Co L₃ RIXS研究应变调控的(Pr,Y,Ca)CoO₃薄膜价态-自旋-结构-金属绝缘体转变(VSST)，发现压应变膜降温后Pr趋向4+、Co⁴⁺被抑制、以低自旋Co³⁺为主，对应Co–O网络中约0.15个空穴减少；张应变膜谱几乎不随温度变化。
AI.motivation: 应变调控的(Pr₀.₈₅Y₀.₁₅)₀.₇Ca₀.₃CoO₃薄膜是研究钙钛矿钴氧化物中价态、自旋态、结构与金属-绝缘体转变耦合的理想模型体系，但缺少元素分辨的局域电子结构证据，尤其Pr与Co–O子晶格间电荷补偿机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 外延薄膜分别生长在压应变的YAlO₃(YAO)与张应变的LSAT衬底上；测量Co L₂,₃和Pr M₄,₅边XAS以及Co L₃边RIXS，跨越应变控制的VSST进行变温探测；并用多重态(multiplet)计算拟合XAS线形与高能损处的局域dd激发。
AI.result: 压应变YAO薄膜降温穿过转变时出现类Pr⁴⁺谱重、Co⁴⁺特征被抑制，Co³⁺以低自旋为主；Pr与Co边的变化定量对应Co–O网络中每Co约减少0.15个空穴。张应变LSAT薄膜谱几乎与温度无关。多重态计算复现了主要XAS线形和高能损dd激发；转变温度以上的低能RIXS强度可由类Co⁴⁺局域激发与金属相对应的较宽粒子-空穴连续谱共同解释。
AI.conclusion: 给出了Pr与Co–O子晶格间电荷补偿的元素分辨证据，支持在应变调控VSST中电荷转移、自旋态与晶格结构之间的协同耦合。

title: Dysfunctional Functionals and their Therapies in Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
summary: The exchange-correlation functional in Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory (TDDFT) is known to have dependence on past densities and initial states, and yet this memory-dependence is ignored in practical calculations which almost always use an adiabatic approximation. We discuss the dysfunction that arises due to this deficiency and point to therapies that go beyond the adiabatic approximation. Still, adiabatic TDDFT has had success in a wide range of systems for response properties and for fully non-equilibrium dynamics, and why this is so is only partially understood. This, together with the rigorous foundation of the exact theory and its favorable system-size scaling, provides tremendous impetus for continuing to strive towards improved approximations to the exact functionals, and a deeper understanding of the impact of approximations in applications.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论TDDFT中交换关联泛函的记忆依赖问题，指出实际计算普遍采用绝热近似而忽略记忆效应，分析该缺陷导致的"功能障碍"，并指出超越绝热近似的改进方向。
AI.motivation: 精确TDDFT的交换关联泛函本质上依赖历史密度和初始态（记忆效应），但实用计算几乎一律采用绝热近似忽略这一依赖。作者希望厘清这种缺失带来的问题，并解释绝热TDDFT为何在诸多体系中仍然成功。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述/观点性文章，通过概念性分析讨论绝热近似造成的"dysfunction"（功能障碍），并梳理超越绝热近似（引入记忆效应）的可行途径，同时审视绝热TDDFT成功的原因。
AI.result: 指出绝热近似忽略记忆效应会导致特定失效情形，但同时观察到绝热TDDFT在响应性质和完全非平衡动力学等广泛体系中表现良好，这一现象仅被部分理解。
AI.conclusion: 精确理论具有严格基础和有利的体系尺度标度，加之绝热TDDFT的广泛成功，共同构成持续改进泛函近似、并深入理解近似在应用中影响的强大动力。

title: VESPER: Online Learning of Free Energies with a Multi-Tempered Variational Objective
summary: Computing molecular free-energy landscapes over collective variables (CVs) is central to understanding molecular mechanisms, but poses a difficult learning problem without training data available a priori. Samples of the marginal CV distribution must be generated by molecular dynamics (MD), whose trajectories can remain trapped in metastable states and rarely cross the free-energy barriers governing conformational changes or chemical reactions. We introduce VESPER, which couples the generation of these samples to neural-network-driven free-energy learning: MD supplies configurations for learning, while the evolving model biases the MD to accelerate exploration and generate further training data. VESPER minimizes a single variational objective that is convex in the free energy and can combine several tempering levels, each flattening the free-energy landscape to promote barrier crossing. Every level has the same physical free energy as its minimizer, allowing data from all levels to train one shared model without reweighting. Learning uses the difference in mean parameter gradients between biased MD configurations and auxiliary walkers that explore the flattened model in CV space. We prove conditional convergence of the coupled overdamped population dynamics without replica exchange under log-Sobolev and Polyak-Lojasiewicz assumptions. VESPER matches or improves on established enhanced-sampling methods on alanine dipeptide and yields self-consistent free-energy reconstructions from three to six CVs on alanine tetrapeptide. For methane dehydrogenation on Ni(511) with a machine-learned interatomic potential, it recovers two-CV Boltzmann marginals and a reactant-to-saddle free-energy difference along a three-CV path, both qualitatively consistent with the lower-dimensional reference. It also samples RMSD-defined folded and unfolded regions of chignolin while biasing seventeen CVs.

AI.tldr: VESPER 将 MD 采样与神经网络自由能学习耦合在一个变分目标下，用多tempering层展平自由能景观加速跨垒，并在多个分子体系上实现多CV自洽自由能重建。
AI.motivation: 计算分子自由能景观缺乏先验训练数据，需由 MD 生成 CV 边缘分布样本，但 MD 轨迹易陷于亚稳态、极少跨越决定构象变化或化学反应的自由能垒。
AI.method: 构建单一变分目标（对自由能凸），耦合样本生成与神经网络自由能学习：MD 提供构型、演化中的模型反过来偏置 MD 加速探索；可组合多个 tempering 层，每层展平景观且共享同一物理自由能，故各层数据无需重加权即可训练同一模型；学习用被偏置 MD 构型与在展平模型 CV 空间游走的辅助 walker 之间的平均参数梯度差；并证明在对数 Sobolev 与 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 假设下、无 replica exchange 的过阻尼群体动力学条件收敛。
AI.result: 在丙氨酸二肽上匹配或优于现有增强采样方法；在丙氨酸四肽上从 3–6 个 CV 得到自洽自由能重建；在 Ni(511) 甲烷脱氢（机器学习势）上恢复两 CV Boltzmann 边缘分布及三 CV 路径上的反应物—鞍点自由能差，均与低维参考定性一致；在偏置 17 个 CV 时仍能采样 chignolin 的 RMSD 折叠/去折叠区域。
AI.conclusion: VESPER 提供了一种无需先验数据、可扩展至高维 CV 的自洽增强采样与自由能学习框架，兼具理论收敛保证与多体系实证效果。

title: Molecular conical intersections with odd electron number are realizations of the topological Yang monopole
summary: The two-level conical intersection of a molecule with odd electron number in the absence of magnetic field obeys time-reversal symmetry $T^{2}=-1$ (referred to as the $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersection), and has a five-dimensional branching space due to the Kramer degeneracy. Similar to how the conical intersection of a molecule in a magnetic field ($T^{2}=0$) behaves as the Dirac monopole, the $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersection behaves as the Yang monopole, an mathematical generalization of Dirac monopole with SU(2) gauge field and SO(5) symmetry. This implies that we can study topological properties of $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersections in chemistry based on what is known about Yang monopole in high energy physics. In this work, we present a few mathematical tools to study this connection. First, we show that geometric algebra and quaternion numbers together provides a natural way to utilize the $T^{2}=-1$ time reversal symmetry and the SO(5) symmetry in scaled coordinates, making it simple to derive eigenfunctions, Berry connection and Berry curvature of $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersection. In particular, this approach provides a simple proof that when viewed from the upper or lower states, the $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersection behaves as the self-dual or self-antidual Yang monopole with second Chern number $C_{2}=+\frac{1}{4}$ or $-\frac{1}{4}$ respectively. In addition, we propose a visualization method for the SU(2) Berry connection of $T^{2}=-1$ conical intersection. This is achieved by showing that the nonzero part of the Berry connection induces Hopf-fibration on the $S^{3}$ longitude space, and is further visualized through stereographic projection.

AI.tldr: 本文用几何代数与四元数方法研究无磁场下奇数电子分子体系的 $T^2=-1$ 锥形交叉，证明其上/下能级分别表现为自对偶/反自对偶 Yang 单极子（第二陈数 $C_2=+\tfrac14$ / $-\tfrac14$），并给出 SU(2) Berry 联络的 Hopf 纤维化可视化方案。
AI.motivation: 奇数电子分子在无磁场时具有时间反演对称性 $T^2=-1$ 与 Kramers 简并，其两点锥形交叉具有五维分支空间。类比磁场下（$T^2=0$）锥形交叉对应 Dirac 单极子，$T^2=-1$ 情形应对应具有 SU(2) 规范场与 SO(5) 对称性的 Yang 单极子，从而可借用高能物理中 Yang 单极子的已知结果来研究化学中的拓扑性质。作者希望建立这一联系所需的数学工具。
AI.method: 1) 采用几何代数加四元数，在缩放坐标下自然处理 $T^2=-1$ 时间反演对称性与 SO(5) 对称性，简洁导出本征函数、Berry 联络和 Berry 曲率；2) 以此给出上/下能级分别对应自对偶/反自对偶 Yang 单极子及第二陈数 $C_2=\pm 1/4$ 的简单证明；3) 提出 SU(2) Berry 联络的可视化方法：指出 Berry 联络的非零部分在 $S^3$ 经度空间上诱导 Hopf 纤维化，并通过球极投影加以展示。
AI.result: 几何代数-四元数框架可简洁地得到 $T^2=-1$ 锥形交叉的本征函数、Berry 联络与曲率；证明了从上能级或下能级看，该交叉分别表现为自对偶或反自对偶 Yang 单极子，第二陈数分别为 $C_2=+1/4$ 和 $-1/4$；并成功通过 Hopf 纤维化与球极投影实现了 SU(2) Berry 联络的可视化。
AI.conclusion: $T^2=-1$ 锥形交叉在拓扑上等价于 Yang 单极子，本文提供的几何代数/四元数工具与 Hopf 纤维化可视化方法，为在化学体系中系统研究此类拓扑性质、并借用高能物理中 Yang 单极子的结论奠定了基础。

title: Simple algorithm for evaluating SU(2) non-abelian geometric phase in the vicinity of molecular conical intersection of odd electron number
summary: Molecular conical intersection of odd-electron number are known to give arise to non-abelian geometric phases. In this work, we present a simple algorithm for evaluating the SU(2) geometric phases given a trajectory represented as a discrete set of coordinates in the 5-dimensional branching space. Motivated by the special property that such conical intersection behaves as abelian ones in 3-dimensional subspace, we take two steps to establish the algorithm. We first prove that it is possible to construct an augmented trajectory consisting of spherical triangles that has the same geometric phases as the original trajectory. We then prove that the geometric phase contribution from each spherical triangle can be evaluated from its properties using Stokes' theorem in a way that closely resembles abelian conical intersections. The total geometric phases are thus evaluated by path-ordered products of contributions from each spherical triangle. Based on the augmented trajectory, we further show that the geometric phases of the upper and lower states will switch under inversion transformation of the trajectory. This relation is further generalized to show that the Wilson loop, defined as the trace of the geometric phases, will switch between the two states under any 5-dimensional improper isometric transformation. Example calculations of geometric phases for trajectories generated on 5-dimensional polytopes are also presented and discussed.

AI.tldr: 提出一种计算奇数电子数分子锥形交叉产生的SU(2)非阿贝尔几何相位的简单算法：将离散轨迹扩充为球面三角形构成的轨迹，再用类斯托克斯定理逐三角形求相位并按路径排序相乘。
AI.motivation: 奇数电子数的分子锥形交叉会产生非阿贝尔几何相位，但在5维分支空间中给定离散坐标轨迹时，缺乏简单有效的计算SU(2)几何相位的方法。
AI.method: 利用此类锥形交叉在3维子空间中表现如阿贝尔锥形交叉的性质，分两步：(1) 证明可构造由球面三角形组成、几何相位与原轨迹相同的扩充轨迹；(2) 证明每个球面三角形的几何相位贡献可用斯托克斯定理由其性质求得，总相位为各贡献的路径排序乘积。
AI.result: 证明在轨迹反演变换下上下态几何相位互换；并推广为任意5维非正常等距变换下Wilson环（几何相位的迹）在两个态之间互换。还对5维多面体上生成的轨迹做了示例计算。
AI.conclusion: 该算法将非阿贝尔几何相位计算转化为类似阿贝尔情形、可逐三角形局域求解的过程，并揭示了反演及非正常等距变换下的相位互换规律，对分子锥形交叉的几何相位研究有实用价值。

title: PLUMED-JAX: GPU-native enhanced sampling for atomistic simulations
summary: We present PLUMED-JAX, an AI-assisted adaptation of selected PLUMED collective variables, umbrella sampling, and metadynamics for JAX-based atomistic simulations, developed using gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning effort set to high within the Codex harness. Integration with JAX-MD supports compiled molecular dynamics, batched replicas, walkers sharing a bias, and execution across multiple graphics processing units. We validate the framework against PLUMED and exact free energy benchmarks, and demonstrate applications to butane, silicon crystallization, and lithium transport, with severalfold improvements in computational throughput for both classical forcefields and machine learning interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PLUMED-JAX：借助 AI（gpt-6.1-sol，Codex 框架，高推理强度）将 PLUMED 的部分集体变量、伞形采样与元动力学适配到 JAX 生态，可与 JAX-MD 集成，实现编译化分子动力学、批量副本、共享偏置的 walker 及多 GPU 执行。
AI.motivation: PLUMED 功能强大但基于传统实现，难以与 JAX 的即时编译、批处理和多 GPU 高性能计算流程结合；同时 AI 辅助代码移植展现出潜力，需要检验其在科学软件中的可行性与正确性。
AI.method: 用 AI 辅助（gpt-6.1-sol + Codex，高推理强度）移植 PLUMED 中的若干集体变量、伞形采样和元动力学算法到 JAX；与 JAX-MD 集成以支持编译化 MD、批量副本、共享偏置的 walker 与多 GPU 运行；并对照 PLUMED 及精确自由能基准进行验证。
AI.result: 在 PLUMED 与精确自由能基准上验证通过；在丁烷、硅结晶和锂传输三类体系上成功演示；对经典力场与机器学习原子间势均取得数倍计算吞吐提升。
AI.conclusion: PLUMED-JAX 表明 AI 辅助的科学软件移植可获得正确且高效的增强采样实现，并显著加速 JAX 体系下的增强采样模拟。

title: A $θ$-implicit hybrid particle-in-cell algorithm for kinetic simulations of magnetized plasmas
summary: Hybrid particle-in-cell (PIC) models with kinetic ions and an inertialess electron fluid are widely used to simulate magnetized plasmas at ion scales, but explicit time advances are constrained by the whistler-wave CFL condition $\dt \propto Δx^2$, and the sub-cycling and artificial dissipation used to mitigate it carry accumulating costs. We present a $θ$-implicit hybrid PIC algorithm, implemented in the open-source GPU-capable code WarpX, in which fields and particles are advanced as a single nonlinear system solved by a particle-suppressed Jacobian-free Newton--Krylov method: the particles are nonlinearly eliminated, the electric field of the generalized Ohm's law is the sole unknown, and mass matrices remove all particle operations from the linear iterations. The electron pressure is advanced inside the nonlinear solve, and the scheme satisfies a discrete energy law whose single dissipation term vanishes at $θ= 1/2$ and damps only temporally under-resolved modes for $θ> 1/2$. The advance reproduces parallel and perpendicular wave dispersion including the ion Bernstein modes, conserves total energy to machine roundoff where the explicit advance heats secularly, does not develop the cold-beam finite-grid instability, and reproduces the $m=0$ instability of a Bennett pinch in RZ geometry. We conclude with 3D simulations of a field-reversed configuration initialized from a Grad--Shafranov equilibrium, comparing the explicit and implicit advances on the growth of the tilt instability and the preservation of trapped magnetic flux.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在 WarpX 中实现的 θ-隐式混合 PIC 算法，将场与粒子作为单一非线性系统求解（无 Jacobian 的 Newton–Krylov 法，粒子被非线性消去，仅电场为未知量，质量矩阵使线性迭代中无粒子操作），突破显式推进的哨声波 CFL 限制（Δt∝Δx²），同时保持能量守恒性质。
AI.motivation: 离子尺度磁化等离子体的混合 PIC 模型（动理学离子 + 无质量电子流体）广泛使用，但显式时间推进受哨声波 CFL 条件限制（Δt∝Δx²），用于缓解的子循环与人工耗散会带来累积代价，因此需要更高效的隐式方案。
AI.method: θ-隐式混合 PIC 算法：场与粒子作为单一非线性系统，用粒子抑制的 Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov 方法求解；粒子被非线性消除，广义 Ohm 定律中的电场为唯一未知量，质量矩阵将粒子操作从线性迭代中移除；电子压力在非线性求解内部推进。该格式满足离散能量定律，其单一耗散项在 θ=1/2 时消失，在 θ>1/2 时仅对时间上欠分辨模式进行耗散。
AI.result: 能够复现平行与垂直波色散（包括离子 Bernstein 模式）；总能量守恒至机器精度（而显式推进会出现长期加热）；不产生冷束有限网格不稳定性；在 RZ 几何中复现 Bennett 箍缩的 m=0 不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 最后给出从 Grad–Shafranov 平衡初始化场反位形（FRC）的 3D 模拟，比较显式与隐式推进在倾斜不稳定性增长及俘获磁通保持方面的表现。

title: Transient subtraction method: An alternative approach for variance reduction in dissipative particle dynamics
summary: The efficient and accurate computation of transport coefficients remains a numerical challenge in dissipative particle dynamics (DPD), which can require substantial sampling to control statistical uncertainty. We extend recent results obtained in Langevin dynamics to consider the transient subtraction method for reducing the variance of transport coefficient estimations in DPD. The system is initialised by perturbing equilibrium samples, and its relaxation towards equilibrium is monitored under the reference dynamics. A reference trajectory, initialised at equilibrium and driven by the same Brownian noise, provides a control variate for the transient response. We apply the transient subtraction method to the computation of the mobility and the shear viscosity in a Lennard-Jones fluid in DPD. The shear viscosity is obtained from the time-integrated response of a Fourier observable associated with the longitudinal velocity. Numerical comparisons with the naive transient estimator show that the transient subtraction method reduces the variance at various integration times, and the reduction is more pronounced with a higher friction coefficient. These results indicate that the transient subtraction method is able to improve the statistical precision of transport coefficient estimations in DPD and reduce the number of trajectories needed to attain a prescribed standard error.
